description.zh: 是否立即释放实例。默认false，实例数据会继续保留7天，然后删除；如果选择true，实例数据会被立刻删除。
description.en: Specifies whether to release the instance immediately. If set to true, the instance and its data are deleted immediately. If set to false (the default), the instance is retained for seven days before being permanently deleted.
The instance ID. You can call the [GetLindormInstanceList](~~426069~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hitsdb release-lindorm-instance --instance-id ld-bp1z3506imz2f0000 --immediately false --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
